items.summary: 👋 Hey everyone! The Mixpanel EMEA marketing team have been sitting on some data that's too good not to share with this community. The EMEA findings are turning heads and we think every ecommerce leader in this group should see them. Here's everything we've put together, and why it's worth your time: 📊 The 2026 State of Digital Analytics Report We benchmarked ecommerce performance across 8 industries and 4 global regions. This analysis unpacks the single biggest shift happening across ecommerce right now. The blog covers everything from chasing acquisition volume to building genuine user habits and why EMEA teams are feeling it most. It also explains the difference between metrics that predict durable growth and the vanity metrics that create noise. A quick read that reframes how you think about measurement. Read the blog (https://mixpanel.com/blog/ecommerce-benchmarks-2026/?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-emea-ecommerce-campaign&utm_content=slack-soda-blog).
